name: VESTING DAY
description: An agent for England's merging councils (West Surrey, vesting day 1 April 2027). It federates three councils' published spend, contracts and Council Tax Support policy in place, resolves which suppliers they share, remembers every human decision with the Meterless H-MEM engine so later answers change, finds the contract cliff and the policy gaps residents hit on day one, and drafts the first actions under a human approval gate.

sample_mode.needs: nothing: no Zetaris, no Nightshift, no Companies House, no network
sample_mode.data: data/sample - the councils' published files mapped to one schema with provenance ids (data/raw holds the originals, data/raw/MANIFEST.md the URLs and hashes)
sample_mode.model: deterministic template badged sample-mode/template; all numbers computed at run time

agents.name: Router
agents.role: Classifies a free-text request into a supported flow or returns a structured unsupported error

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Runs federated SQL against the data layer (Zetaris live; cached council files in sample mode)

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Normalises supplier names, scores cross-council matches, applies remembered decisions and Companies House identity

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Meterless H-MEM: recalls and stores human decisions with provenance

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Validates provenance and thresholds; rejects and returns work below the bar

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts briefings and letters from the evidence table (NVIDIA Nemotron via Meterless Nightshift)

agents.name: ApprovalGate
agents.role: Holds drafts for human approval and records human confirmations; no autonomous action

sponsor_technology.zetaris: data layer: the three councils' spend, contracts and policy tables are registered in Zetaris and queried in place over its REST API (app/adapters/datalayer.py)
sponsor_technology.meterless_engine: H-MEM, implemented as a Python port of the reference (app/engines/hmem), conformance 13/13 on the upstream vectors (tests/test_hmem_conformance.py), bit-exact against the TypeScript reference (tests/test_hmem_golden.py), used by the Memory agent
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: primary AI provider: app/adapters/nightshift.py speaks Nightshift's OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the runtime token; every response's signed compute receipt is kept
sponsor_technology.nvidia: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b through Nightshift for the Writer and the match judge; the model name is logged per request

traces: logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl, one JSON object per agent action, written by the agents as they run
inputs: input_examples/*.json (run 01, 02, 03 in order to see memory change the answer)
data_period: the newest six months each council has published (Woking Nov 2025-Apr 2026 monthly; Guildford and Waverley Apr-Sep 2026); every answer carries a per-council period badge
synthetic_data: data/sample/residents_synthetic.csv only, labelled SYNTHETIC in every output
limitations: Supplier identity below the exact/Companies-House bar is never asserted; it is queued for a human
Only the Lightning Nemotron lane is used (the Super-class endpoints were unavailable to this account during the event)
Waverley's Council Tax Support scheme is not yet in the clause table; the policy flow covers Woking and Guildford
